question: What is the main goal of Health Maintenance Agencies (HMAs) compared to traditional hospitals?
explanation: You've got this! HMAs focus more on stopping sickness before it starts through health education and check-ups, rather than just treating people after they get sick. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T6#GNS112_U1_T6_h1)

question: When a community nurse works with an HMA, what is one of their main jobs?

options.A: Translate health policies into community action

explanation: Great job! Nurses act as the friendly bridge between government health rules and the actual health habits of everyday people in the community. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T6#GNS112_U1_T6_h1)

question: What do we call the process of tracking disease outbreaks in a population?
explanation: Spot on! Disease surveillance simply means keeping a close eye on health data so we can catch and stop infectious outbreaks early. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T6#GNS112_U1_T6_h2)

question: An HMA official checking local food vendors to make sure they keep their stalls clean is doing what?
explanation: Well done! Checking that places follow safety and hygiene laws is what we call regulatory enforcement. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T6#GNS112_U1_T6_h2)

question: Which agency is mainly responsible for setting up primary health care programs across Nigeria?

options.B: National Primary Health Care Development Agency
options.C: Medical and Dental Council of Nigeria

explanation: That's right! The NPHCDA is the main body tasked with coordinating primary health care development nationwide in Nigeria. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T6#GNS112_U1_T6_h3)

question: Why is it helpful for a nursing student to understand Nigeria's healthcare system levels?

options.A: It dictates how patient referrals and health resources flow
options.B: It allows them to bypass hospital management boards
options.C: It exempts them from paying professional licensing fees
options.D: It helps them secure foreign scholarships easily

explanation: Spot on! Knowing the health system hierarchy helps you understand how patient transfers and medical supplies move smoothly between hospitals. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T6#GNS112_U1_T6_h3)

question: Which global health body gives leadership and advice during worldwide health emergencies?
explanation: You got it! The WHO is the leading international agency that guides countries through global health crises. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T6#GNS112_U1_T6_h4)

question: How do international health partners usually help Nigeria's healthcare system?

options.A: Handling domestic taxation for health workers
options.B: Replacing local nursing training institutions completely
options.C: Taking over full management of all local hospitals
options.D: Providing funding, technical expertise, and logistical support

explanation: Correct! Global partners support local efforts by sharing funds, expert advice, and resources that might otherwise be scarce. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T6#GNS112_U1_T6_h4)

question: What is the main purpose of sending a patient through a healthcare referral system?

options.A: To punish primary health centers for poor performance
options.B: To generate more revenue for tertiary teaching hospitals
options.C: To ensure patients receive care at the appropriate level of complexity
options.D: To reduce the total number of patients visiting clinics

explanation: Exactly! Referrals make sure patients get sent to the right facility that has the exact equipment and specialists they need. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T6#GNS112_U1_T6_h5)

question: What must a nurse make sure of when transferring a patient from a local clinic to a teaching hospital?

options.A: The patient pays a fine for getting sicker
options.B: All family members are discharged home first
options.C: Proper handover communication and clinical records accompany them
options.D: The local clinic doctor takes over the tertiary bed

explanation: Well done! Clear notes and a good verbal handover are vital to keep the patient safe and ensure smooth continuous care. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T6#GNS112_U1_T6_h5)

question: Which of these is NOT a common challenge faced by health agencies in Nigeria?
explanation: Spot on! Nigerian health agencies usually battle with shortages and deficits, so having an "excessive surplus" of medical supplies is definitely not a common problem. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T6#GNS112_U1_T6_h6)

question: How are modern health agencies trying to improve disease tracking and patient care?

options.A: Relying exclusively on paper-based filing systems
options.C: Abolishing primary health care centers entirely
options.D: Adopting digital health records and mobile health platforms

explanation: You nailed it! Technology like electronic health records and mobile tools help agencies track health trends and manage data much faster. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T6#GNS112_U1_T6_h6)
